analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Limited held its earnings call on May 16, 2026, to discuss its financial performance and operations for FY26. The company reported a total sales volume of 15,000 metric tons in FY26 and highlighted an existing order book of roughly 4,000 metric tons for Microcrystalline Cellulose (MCC). Commercialization of Unit 3 Phase 1 was delayed due to abnormal monsoons and pending regulatory approvals, but trials and launch are expected shortly upon receiving remaining clearances. Management emphasized its strategic focus on scaling premium range excipient products such as MCC spheres and wood pulp-based Croscarmellose Sodium (CCS). Accent Microcell Limited reported financial results for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in revenue and profitability.

guidance.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 1 to fetch peak capacity revenue of around 150 crores.
guidance.quote: At peak capacity, we are assuming revenue of around, 150 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects Unit 3 Phase 1 to operate for 9 months in FY27.
guidance.quote: Sir, we are expecting it to be running for 9 months instead of 6 months, so accordingly, the figures may vary.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall blended profit margins to increase by at least 2-3 percentage points as premium product sales expand.
guidance.quote: It will be prudent enough to assume going ahead, as we are going ahead with more premium range of products, so it is prudent enough to assume that the blended profit margins are going to increase by, say, at least 2-3 percentage.

guidance.claim: The share of premium products in revenue for FY27 is expected to reach 16 to 17%.
guidance.quote: Gradually, it is going to increase, but for H2 or for entire finance year 27, it's going to be, say, more or less 16 to 17%.

guidance.claim: The company projected ₹70 crore in revenue in Year 1 from capacity expansion.
The company expects a 15-20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: Just a moment, sir, at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

demand_outlook.claim: Current MCC demand outlook is strong based on the existing order book.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currency, current, MCC demand outlook is good, taking into account our existing order book.

demand_outlook.claim: Export revenue increased to roughly 63% of total revenue in FY26 from 53% in the prior year.
demand_outlook.quote: ODAC exports, it's roughly, say, around 63%, which was, 53% last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic realization for MCC ranges between 170 to 190 rupees per kg.
demand_outlook.quote: The domestic realization ranges between anywhere between 170 to 190 rupees.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic selling prices for CMC are around Rs 400 per kg, while foreign export prices range from Rs 800 to 900 per kg.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, in domestic selling price of CMC is almost Rs 400Kg and for foreign its selling price will be Rs 800 to 900Kg for export.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing increased product inquiries for their MCC range.
demand_outlook.quote: If we look into the oral pharma and particular segment where we have been supplying the product range, so, of course is, there has been product. Inquiry has been increased, and we have been taking care of the business from our business side.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 will cater to a premium range of excipient products, while Phase 2 will focus on MCC.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 will cater to, say, a premium range of excipient products, and Phase 2 will cater to MCC.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity of Unit 3 Phase 1 is 2,400 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: the capacity of, Unit 3, phase 1 is 2,400 metric ton per nm.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 2 to go live in March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Sir, Phase 2, say, it will be premature for me to give any kind of an exact deadline, but as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

capex_expansion.claim: Accent Microcell has purchased land sufficient to expand up to Phase 6.
capex_expansion.quote: Good question Mr. Priyank, we have purchased land for till phase 6.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 3 expansion is tentatively planned to commence in 2028 following success in Phase 2.
capex_expansion.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 is expected to be commercialized by the end of October or early November 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, sir. By say, quarter 3 of the current financial year. So anywhere between, say by the end of October or in the 1st couple of weeks of November.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a gross profit percentage of around 38%.
Nominal cost increases for imported wood pulp raw material have been fully passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, whatever the, say, nominal increase in the cost, for the import of raw material that is wood pulp has been completely passed on through the customer.

margins_costs.claim: Margin generated from trading activities is around 4-5%.
margins_costs.quote: Trading margins are 4-5%, as compared to the, blended profit margins that what you are seeing in the phase of the profit and loss account.

margins_costs.claim: Accent Microcell imports raw material wood pulp from USA, Sweden, Canada, and Indonesia, and not from China.
margins_costs.quote: So, basically, we import it from USA, Sweden, Canada, Indonesia.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 18.18% for FY26.
The company reported a PAT margin of 12.57% for FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Accent Microcell has an executable order book of roughly 4,000 metric tons for MCC across export and domestic markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Taking into account, say, domestic and export market, we have roughly around, 4,000 metric tons orders on hand with us.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume achieved in FY26 was 15,000 metric tons.
Installed capacity for MCC Spheres is 100 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, say, we have, say, around, 100 metric ton capacity for MCC Spears

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for both existing plants combined is roughly around 10,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Yeah, and the installed capacity for both the plant is roughly around 10,000 metric ton.

orders_capacity.claim: Pirana Unit I has an installed capacity of 2,000 MTPA with 100% capacity utilisation.
Dahej SEZ Unit II has an installed capacity of 7,200 MTPA with 95% capacity utilisation.
The company currently has business orders on hand for the next 4 to 5 months.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, we have at present about, you can say for 4 to 5 months. We have business on hand, and that's why.

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 2 expansion will be funded through a rights issue and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Because Phase 2, Phase 2, we are going to fund it out from right issue, and to a certain extent, internal equals.

capital_allocation.claim: Management does not foresee any additional debt requirements for future expansion phases.
capital_allocation.quote: I think, the internal accruals will suffice the requirement. As of now, we don't see any kind of such debt requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital stretch in receivables is expected to be resolved by the end of FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Sir, if not by, H1 of financial year 27, surely by, say, end of financial 27, it will be taken care of.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's revenue mix from the capacity expansion is projected to be 60% exports and 40% domestic sales.
The company may consider taking on a nominal amount of debt if required for working capital needs.
capital_allocation.quote: So that will be premature for us to comment technical account. One need to understand the requirement of the working capital for phase one as well. So, if required nominal amount of debt can be thought of.

risks_headwinds.claim: Delay in commercializing Phase 1 was driven by abnormal monsoons and regulatory licensing for a greenfield project.
risks_headwinds.quote: The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield.

risks_headwinds.claim: Profitability at the Pirana unit was impacted by an exceptional cost item related to new labor codes.
risks_headwinds.quote: And in addition to OBO, there was an, say, kind of an exceptional item in the current year as well, wherein the, huge impact of the labor code was also taken by us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions have caused transit time delays without impacting product prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sir in this the situation is that due to geopolitical tension there is no fluctuation in prices. Whatever delay there is and whatever challenges there are they are related to transit time to the extent what you have understood so far.

risks_headwinds.claim: The implementation schedule for Unit-III has been re-aligned owing to two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities.
risks_headwinds.quote: Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities

risks_headwinds.claim: Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining required regulatory approvals also affected the implementation schedule.
risks_headwinds.quote: Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining the required regulatory approvals

risks_headwinds.claim: Management does not foresee any negative impact on raw material sourcing due to geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, the territory within which, from which we are importing the goods that would. There is no such issue so far. So we don't expect any kind of negative impact for sourcing of our raw material.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 1 to operate for 9 months in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, we are expecting it to be running for 9 months instead of 6 months, so accordingly, the figures may vary.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Phase 2 of Unit 3 to go live in March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, Phase 2, say, it will be premature for me to give any kind of an exact deadline, but as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

management_commitments.claim: Management tentatively plans to start Phase 3 in 2028.
management_commitments.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects trade receivables stretch to normalize by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, if not by, H1 of financial year 27, surely by, say, end of financial 27, it will be taken care of.

management_commitments.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 will reach 60% capacity utilization in its first year.
management_commitments.quote: Sir. Look into the various guidelines in place. I won't be able to quantify in terms of financial figure, but yes, from the from current fiscal given a full year capacity, we are expecting it to be utility level, to be around 60% for the 1st year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
